name: team_planning_scenarios
description: List the scenarios of a Team Planning plan the caller is in. The baseline comes first: its id is the plan's, it stands on the base date and has no parent, relation or end. Each other scenario has its parent_id, its relation ('then' follows the parent, 'instead' is an alternative to it, 'on' is the rest of a split step, sitting on its agreed part), its period and what it is for, if an editor has said. Refused, as an unknown plan, unless the caller is a member.
